about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER
about.bio: Fullstack Developer with hands-on experience in ReactJS, Node.js, and FastAPI, contributing to the development of scalable web applications and enterprise AI solutions. Experienced in integrating LLMs, LangChain, and RAG into real-world products to automate business workflows and enhance user productivity. Passionate about building high-quality software, continuously learning new technologies, and delivering practical solutions that create business value.

info.location: Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.subtitle: Where I've been applying my skills to solve real business problems.

responsibilities: **Designed and implemented a Keycloak-based Single Sign-On (SSO) solution**, integrating **Redis** for session management to **centralize authentication and user access** across the enterprise ecosystem.
**Containerized and deployed the SSO service with Docker**, configuring **production-ready environments** and integrating it with multiple applications to **ensure stable authentication services**.

**Developed an LLM-powered Document Intelligence application** using **LangChain**, **FastAPI**, and **RAG**, supporting **contract and enterprise document analysis** for **legal risk assessment**, unfavorable clause detection, and contextual revision recommendations.

**Implemented semantic document comparison and a RAG-based Question Answering (QA) system**, enabling **natural-language document retrieval**, contextual answers, and **inline editing of AI-generated recommendations** within the document preview.
**Built asynchronous document export workflows with Celery/ARQ**, generating **structured PDF reports** and **DOCX Track Changes documents** to support **collaborative document review and revision**.

**Developed Helpdesk interfaces and backend APIs** using **ReactJS** and **FastAPI**, integrating **MinIO** for file and image storage while **supporting the platform's migration toward a plugin-based architecture**.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Real-world products I have participated in designing and developing.

items.title: StarPrep AI – AI-powered Resume Intelligence Platform
items.description: Full-stack AI platform for ATS resume optimization, AI-powered resume and cover letter generation, and interview preparation.
highlights: Engineered a GPT-4o resume analysis pipeline with structured prompts, JSON Schema validation, and retry mechanisms for ATS scoring, JD matching, and STAR-based optimization.
Built AI generation modules for tailored CVs and cover letters featuring automated keyword optimization, multilingual translation, and tone refinement.
Developed a Notion-style CV Builder with live preview, auto-save, undo/redo state management, and Playwright-powered PDF export.
Implemented an AI usage & analytics module to track token consumption, enforce subscription quotas, and optimize operational costs.
Integrated VNPay (HMAC-SHA512) for secure payment processing, subscription management (Free/Pro plans), and quota enforcement.
Deployed the production-ready architecture using Docker, hosting the backend on Azure, frontend on Vercel, and database on Aiven (PostgreSQL).

items.title: Human Anomaly Localization
items.description: A real-time AI surveillance system applying Computer Vision to detect abnormal behaviors (falls), helping to ensure the safety of the elderly and children. Achieved up to 90% accuracy.
highlights: Built a 4-path hybrid detection algorithm (evaluating Bounding Box ratio, angle, and velocity).
Developed a Border Integrity Check mechanism to eliminate camera edge noise.
Established smooth real-time video streaming via WebSocket with FastAPI.
Packaged and served the YOLOv8s-pose model as asynchronous RESTful APIs.

items.title: Jewelry Sales System
items.description: A reception and management system for the diamond appraisal process (following GIA 4C standards) applying Microservices architecture, ensuring smooth operation and easy scalability.
highlights: Developed a valuation lookup interface and an intuitive statistical Dashboard with Next.js.
Built an independent Appraisal Service using Express.js.
Designed an optimized PostgreSQL schema, ensuring data integrity and query speed.
Dockerized all services to unify the deployment environment.

items.title: SEVINA - Car Rental Platform
items.description: A web platform for self-driving car rentals. Integrates maps for positioning, vehicle tracking, and suggests the nearest car stations (10-20km radius) based on user coordinates.
highlights: Built a modern, highly interactive UI/UX using ReactJS, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Integrated Goong Map API for location logic and station distance calculation.
Strictly managed system state with Redux.
Established CI/CD pipeline and automated deployment on Vercel.
